sloka: वाग्यतः सह वैदेह्या भूत्वा नियतमानसः ।श्रीमत्यायतने विष्णोः शिश्ये नरवरात्मजः ॥२-६-४॥
transliteration: vāgyataḥ saha vaidehyā bhūtvā niyatamānasaḥ ।śrīmatyāyatane viṣṇoḥ śiśye naravarātmajaḥ ॥2-6-4॥

translations.english: The son of the king (Rama) partook the remainder of the havis seeking his own welfare. With a restrained mind and a vow of silence, he meditated upon Lord Narayana and slept along with Vaidehi on a wellspread bed of kusha grass in the auspicious temple of lord Visnu.
translations.hindi: जब कैकेयी ने यह कहा, तब पापिनी मन्थरा, रामचन्द्र जी का सवेनारा करने को कैकेयी से बोली
